{"report":"# Maple Records Decision Note

As of 20 July 2026, first-year cost including setup must stay within 10 units, recovery within 4 hours, and all data on premises; current storage is 12 TB (S1). Next-year growth of 4 TB is a forecast, not a current capacity rule (S1).

- A: 8 + 3 setup = 11 units — exceeds budget; cannot be purchased (S1, S2).
- B: 5 + 3 setup = 8 units, but 5-hour recovery exceeds the 4-hour limit; cannot be purchased (S1, S2).
- C: 6 + 2 setup = 8 units, 3-hour recovery, 14 TB, on premises (S2).

C meets every current requirement and is the recommended feasible choice. Before growth beyond 14 TB materializes, verify C's expansion price and post-expansion recovery time, both currently unknown (S2). No reliability or operating-labor data are supplied, so no comparison is made on those dimensions (S2).","notes":"Brief: decision note, 120–170 whitespace words whole-report, only S1/S2, current constraints vs forecast, cite source IDs.

Claims check: costs A=11, B=8, C=8 (S2); recovery 2/5/3h (S2); capacity 24/24/14 TB (S2); all on premises (S2). Constraints: budget ≤10 incl. setup, recovery ≤4h, on-premises, current 12 TB (S1). A fails budget (S1 rule + S2 price). B fails recovery (5>4). C passes all current rules. 4 TB growth = forecast only (S1) — kept separate from current eligibility; C expansion price and recovery unknown (S2). No preference weights or exceptions invented; no reliability/labor comparison due to missing data (S2).

Length: ~160 whitespace words (counted including headings and citations), within 120–170. Rechecked: all options evaluated against all four requirement categories; recommendation and pre-growth check stated; sources cited as (S1)/(S2).

Lite checklist: requirements — met (format, length, sources, comparison, recommendation, future check); claims_and_sources — all claims trace to S1/S2; counterevidence — infeasible options A and B explained; sections — compact note per short-note contract; reader_edit — no process language or internal paths; limitations — missing reliability/labor data and unknown expansion terms disclosed. No independent review run (Lite profile)."}
